about_the_game:
In Demand-Dial Exorcist, you are a seasoned demon hunter on call to confront the unexplainable. Step into haunted homes where ancient demons sow chaos, leaving shattered objects, unsettling noises, and whispers in the dark. Each demon hides its true form, weaving clues into the objects they corrupt and the phenomena they create. Armed with your wits and ritual tools, you must unravel their mysteries, identify their strongest connections, and exorcise them before their malevolence spreads. But beware—the more you uncover, the more dangerous they become. Can you answer the call and banish the darkness, or will the demons claim you as their next victim?


Demand Dial Exorcist is a puzzle game, where the player takes up the role of an exorcist for hire and has to identify the demon inhabiting the flat and perform the corresponding ritual to exercise that demon. The core of the game is a mechanic from an old board game called Mastermind, the pegs are represented by the item that could be found all over the flat. And you need to place the correct items on the pentagram to perform a ritual to exorcise the demon that inhabits the flat. Unusual behaviours could hint you which exact demon it is, so read your Exorcist’s Book carefully so you won’t miss a hint.
